core_prompt: Is this worth more of my time, and why?
todos: Section + sub-section headings only — ignore the prose
Glance references; tick off ones already read (list below)

fields.label: Category
fields.hint: What type of paper is this? Measurement / analysis of existing system / research prototype / review?

fields.label: Contributions
fields.hint: What are the paper's main contributions?

fields.label: Why (not) worth more time
fields.hint: One or two lines. This drives your verdict.

more_fields.label: Context
more_fields.hint: Which other papers is it related to? Which theoretical bases were used?

more_fields.label: Correctness
more_fields.hint: Do the assumptions appear to be valid?

checklist: Category — what type of paper is this?
Context — which papers is it related to, which theoretical bases?
Correctness — do the assumptions appear valid?
Contributions — what are the main contributions?
